privacy.pageDescription: How BYB Construction collects, uses and protects your personal data through this website, and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.intro: This policy explains which personal data BYB Construction collects through this website, why, how long it is kept, and how you can exercise your rights.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.text: {company}, {address}. Company number (BCE/KBO): {vat}. For any question about your data, contact us at {email}.

appointments.title: Booking an appointment
appointments.data: Name, email address, phone number, optional message, chosen service and time slot, website language.
appointments.purpose: To record and manage your request, send you confirmations, changes and cancellations by email, and let you change or cancel your appointment yourself.
appointments.basis: Pre-contractual steps taken at your request (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).

contact.title: Contact form
contact.data: First name, last name, email address, phone number (optional), subject and message.
contact.basis: Legitimate interest in replying to the requests we receive (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).

security.title: Website security
security.data: IP address and email address (temporary counters), anti-robot check.
security.purpose: To protect the forms against automated submissions and abuse.
security.basis: Legitimate interest in securing the website (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).

retention.title: Retention periods
retention.appointmentsUnset: The data of an appointment is kept for as long as needed to manage it and follow up on our relationship, then erased or anonymized. You can ask for it to be erased at any time.
retention.appointments: The data of an appointment is anonymized {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} after its date. You can ask for it to be erased earlier.
retention.contact: Messages sent through the contact form are not stored on the website: they are forwarded by email to our team, who keep them for as long as needed to handle your request.
retention.security: Security counters (IP address, email address) are automatically deleted after 24 hours.

processors.title: Recipients and processors
processors.intro: Your data is never sold. We use service providers who process it on our behalf:
processors.supabase: storage of appointments and management of the team's accounts
processors.cloudinary: hosting of the website's photos and videos
processors.google: displaying maps, only if you click “Show the map”
processors.transfers: Some of these providers may process data outside the European Economic Area. In that case, the transfer is covered by the safeguards provided by the GDPR (adequacy decision or standard contractual clauses).

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.text1: This website uses no advertising cookies and no audience measurement, so no consent banner is needed.
cookies.text2: It only stores on your device what it needs to work: your light or dark theme preference, your language, and the closing of the WhatsApp help bubble for the duration of your visit.
cookies.text3: The Google Maps maps and the WhatsApp button send no data until you click on them.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.access: obtain a copy of the data we hold about you;
rights.erasure: ask for it to be erased;
rights.restriction: ask for its processing to be restricted;
rights.objection: object to processing based on our legitimate interest;
rights.portability: receive your data in a structured format.
rights.how: To exercise these rights, write to us at {email}. We reply within one month. We may ask you to prove your identity. You can also cancel or move an appointment yourself using the link you received by email.
